display.purpose: Section headings in prep content and docs pages. Always paired with navy 4px left-strip ::before and fading hairline ::after.

headline.purpose: Landing page hero text and largest marketing display only.

title.purpose: Viz-caption figure titles. text-wrap: balance. Clash Display only.

body.purpose: Primary reading surface. 72ch max-width. Only in .prep-content and .docs-page contexts.

body-sm.purpose: Card descriptions, supplementary prose outside .prep-content, nav link text.

label.purpose: Mono eyebrows, figure sequence labels, status IDs. 0.18em tracking uppercase.

section-label.purpose: Inline category labels (DESIGN / DSA / BEHAVIORAL). Always in var(--accent-text).

shadows.name: shadow-md
shadows.purpose: Floating chrome: topbar, sidebar drawer overlay.

shadows.name: shadow-xl
shadows.purpose: Modal scrims, command palette, Shepherd.js tour.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default for all named property transitions (background-color, border-color, color, opacity).

motion.name: ease-spring
motion.purpose: View transition FLIP morphing for lumora tab pills (300ms). Mobile sheet entrance (200ms).

motion.name: ease-celebration
motion.purpose: .celebration-badge scale: slight overshoot on entry, restrained enterprise feel.

motion.name: tab-fade-in
motion.purpose: Tab content swap entrance. Apply with key={activeTab} so React remounts.

breakpoints.name: md
breakpoints.note: Lumora rail appears (--lumora-rail-offset: 80px). Docs mobile relaxations apply below this.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The canonical call-to-action. Navy fill, white text, 8px radius. Used for Ask Sona, Save, Submit actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; padding: 10px 20px; background: #3683DC; color: #ffffff; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; border-radius: 8px; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.15s ease-out, opacity 0.15s ease-out, box-shadow 0.15s ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #2265BF; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(37,99,235,0.22), 0 8px 24px rgba(37,99,235,0.12); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(54,131,220,0.55); outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 8px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Transparent fill with border. Hover accents border and text with navy. Used alongside primary for secondary actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; padding: 10px 20px; background: transparent; color: #9BAAB8; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid #26262E; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.15s ease-out, border-color 0.15s ease-out, color 0.15s ease-out; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: #3683DC; color: #2265BF; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(54,131,220,0.55); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Utility action button for dense UI (session row controls, filter reset). Tighter padding than secondary.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; padding: 8px 14px; background: transparent; color: #9BAAB8; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid #26262E; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.15s ease-out, border-color 0.15s ease-out, color 0.15s ease-out; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #1C1C22; color: #F0EEE9; border-color: #32323C; } .ds-btn-ghost:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(54,131,220,0.55); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Toggleable filter pill. Unselected: surface fill with border. Selected: navy fill, white text.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 5px 12px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid #26262E; background: #141417; color: #9BAAB8; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; transition: background-color 0.15s ease-out, border-color 0.15s ease-out, color 0.15s ease-out; } .ds-chip:hover:not(.ds-chip-active) { border-color: #32323C; color: #F0EEE9; } .ds-chip-active { background: #3683DC; border-color: #3683DC; color: #ffffff; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(54,131,220,0.55); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Badge
components.description: Read-only label. Never interactive. Navy, gold, danger, or muted variants. 10px mono uppercase.
components.html: NEW PRO BETA
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 2px 8px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.12em; border-radius: 4px; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; } .ds-badge-primary { background: rgba(54,131,220,0.12); color: #3683DC; border: 1px solid rgba(54,131,220,0.25); } .ds-badge-gold { background: rgba(212,160,67,0.12); color: #8A6B2A; border: 1px solid rgba(212,160,67,0.25); } .ds-badge-danger { background: rgba(239,68,68,0.10); color: #EF4444; border: 1px solid rgba(239,68,68,0.20); }

components.name: Card
components.description: Standard surface container. 12px radius, hairline border, near-invisible rest shadow. Hover darkens border.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #141417; border: 1px solid #26262E; border-radius: 12px; padding: 24px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.3), 0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.35); transition: border-color 0.15s ease-out; } .ds-card:hover { border-color: #32323C; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard text field. Elevated fill, hairline border, navy focus ring glow.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; background: #1C1C22; border: 1px solid #26262E; color: #F0EEE9; border-radius: 8px; padding: 10px 16px; font-size: 15px; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.15s ease-out, box-shadow 0.15s ease-out; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #647084; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #3683DC; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(37,99,235,0.18); }

components.name: Segmented Tab Group
components.description: Pill-shaped segmented control. JetBrains Mono uppercase. Active pill: navy fill. Container: elevated bg with border.
components.css: .ds-tab-group { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 2px; padding: 3px; border-radius: 999px; background: #1C1C22; border: 1px solid #26262E; width: fit-content; } .ds-tab-item { padding: 5px 14px; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; color: #9BAAB8; background: transparent; border: none; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; transition: color 0.15s ease-out, background-color 0.15s ease-out; } .ds-tab-item:hover:not(.ds-tab-active) { color: #F0EEE9; } .ds-tab-active { background: #3683DC; color: #ffffff; font-weight: 700; }

components.name: Section Heading (h2)
components.description: The canonical .prep-content / .docs-page h2 with navy left-strip ::before and fading hairline ::after. The visual backbone of every topic page.
components.css: .ds-section-h2 { position: relative; font-size: 31px; line-height: 1.18; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.016em; color: #2265BF; padding-left: 18px; margin-top: 3rem; margin-bottom: 1.1rem; font-family: 'Clash Display', system-ui, sans-serif; text-wrap: balance; } .ds-section-h2::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0.25em; bottom: 0.25em; width: 4px; border-radius: 0 9999px 9999px 0; background: #3683DC; } .ds-section-h2::after { content: ''; display: block; height: 1px; margin-top: 0.7rem; margin-left: -18px; max-width: 18rem; background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(54,131,220,0.5) 0%, rgba(54,131,220,0.35) 38%, transparent 100%); }

components.name: Viz Figcaption
components.description: Editorial caption panel below diagram PNGs. Eyebrow + display title + body prose. The signature Camora reading surface.
components.html:
Diagram 1 / 3

Write-Ahead Log Architecture

The WAL ensures durability by persisting mutations before they reach the B-tree pages. Recovery reads the log forward from the last checkpoint.
components.css: .ds-viz-caption { font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; padding: 1.125rem 1.5rem 1.25rem; border-bottom: 1px solid #26262E; background: color-mix(in oklab, #1C1C22 60%, transparent); } .ds-viz-eyebrow { display: inline-block; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.18em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #647084; margin-bottom: 0.625rem; } .ds-viz-title { margin: 0; font-family: 'Clash Display', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.125rem; line-height: 1.25; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.012em; color: #F0EEE9; text-wrap: balance; } .ds-viz-body { margin-top: 0.875rem; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.7; color: #F0EEE9; text-wrap: pretty; } .ds-viz-body p { margin: 0 0 0.875rem; } .ds-viz-body p:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }

narrative.overview:
Camora is built for the focused evening study session — a software engineer at a desk with good light, 3 weeks out from an interview loop, going deep on system design or behavioral preparation. The interface must feel like a very good textbook that also knows your weaknesses: authoritative, efficient, never entertaining for its own sake. The Navy Atlas is the visual metaphor: a navigator's instrument, not a dashboard. Navy #3683DC is the structural metal of the instrument; gold #D4A043 is the signal amber on the instrument face, pointing at what matters next.

The product spans two surfaces. Capra (the study product) is long-form: section headings, 72ch measure, sustained reading that earns trust through typographic precision. Lumora (the live interview AI) is dense and time-pressured: monospaced timers, status dots, citation tier badges, single-key affordances under 56px chrome. Both share the navy/gold discipline.

The light theme is a Linode/iximiuz education aesthetic: blue-only, never gold in light mode. --cam-gold-leaf is intentionally aliased to var(--accent) in [data-theme='light']. Blue-only in light; navy-plus-gold in dark.
keyCharacteristics: Dual-theme, single token layer. :root is dark (charcoal substrate). [data-theme='light'] overrides every token. No duplicated stylesheets.

Two accent roles, four uses. Blue for primary actions, focus rings, structure markers, success/info states. Gold for signal, momentum, problem counts, agenda numerals, list markers, hard-difficulty badges.
Hairline-first elevation. Surfaces are flat at rest. 1px var(--border) carries every boundary. Shadows appear only on genuinely floating elements.
19px body floor on Capra prose. .prep-content and .docs-page paragraphs render at 19px/1.75 with a 72ch measure cap.
Named transitions, never transition-all. Every interactive element specifies properties explicitly.
prefers-reduced-motion honored at root. Global @media block disables all keyframe animations in one place.

rules.name: The Two-Accent Rule
rules.body: Navy and gold are the only saturated colors that may carry meaning. Green for success reuses navy; warning reuses gold; only --danger (red) is allowed beyond navy + gold, and only for destructive actions.

rules.name: The Surface-Wash Rule
rules.body: When a tint is needed (hover scrim, state background), use color-mix(in oklab, var(--token) X%, transparent). Never a hardcoded rgba(...).

rules.name: The Light-Mode Gold Ban
rules.body: In [data-theme='light'], --cam-gold-leaf is aliased to var(--accent). This is intentional. Do not restore gold in light mode.

rules.name: The 19px Prose Floor
rules.body: Body text inside .prep-content and .docs-page renders at 19px. No running prose anywhere drops below 15px.

rules.name: The Display-for-Display-Only Rule
rules.body: Clash Display is for headings, titles, and the wordmark. It is never a body font. Body belongs to Nunito Sans / Satoshi.

rules.name: The Heading-Strip Rule
rules.body: Every h2 in .prep-content and .docs-page carries a 4px rounded navy strip ::before and a fading navy gradient hairline ::after. Every h3 carries an 8px navy hexagon glyph. These are structural, not decorative.

rules.name: The Hairline-First Rule
rules.body: Every container starts with a 1px var(--border) border, no shadow. Add shadow only when the element needs to read as floating above the page.

rules.name: The Flat-at-Rest Rule
rules.body: Cards have --shadow-sm as their rest shadow (nearly invisible). The shadow deepens only on state change. A shadowed surface at rest competes with floating chrome for visual hierarchy.

dos: Do use var(--accent) (#3683DC) for structure and var(--cam-gold-leaf) for signal. These are the only two saturated accents.
Do keep body prose at 19px in .prep-content and .docs-page. Constrain measure to 72ch.
Do use color-mix(in oklab, var(--token) X%, transparent) for tints. Never hardcode rgba(...).
Do name every transition property explicitly. Never transition-all.
Do wire focus-visible:outline: 2px solid rgba(54,131,220,0.55) on every interactive element.
Do use .page-wrap on every public page's main content div.
Do include prefers-reduced-motion opt-outs for keyframe animations.
Do keep gold in dark mode only. In light mode --cam-gold-leaf equals var(--accent).
donts: Don't use border-left or border-right greater than 1px as a decorative accent stripe on cards or callouts.
Don't use background-clip: text with a gradient fill on body copy, headings, or navigation.
Don't default to backdrop-blur glassmorphism on cards or panels.
Don't use the hero-metric template (big number + small label + supporting stats + gradient accent).
Don't introduce a third saturated hue. Teal, green, purple, and orange all violate the Two-Accent Rule.
Don't restore gold in light mode. The --cam-gold-leaf: var(--accent) alias is intentional.
Don't use LeetCode-style gamification chrome: XP bars, confetti animations, streaks, badge walls.
Don't use window.confirm / window.alert / window.prompt. Use dialogConfirm / dialogAlert via DialogProvider.
Don't use Mermaid.js for diagrams. Always Graphviz-generated PNGs from the database cache.
Don't use generic SVG icons or literal emoji characters in rendered component content.
Don't use transition-all. Name the properties.
Don't hide destructive or primary actions behind hover-only affordances.
Don't implement long-press, double-tap, or swipe gesture controls.
